title: Who&When Pro: Can LLMs Really Attribute Failures in AI Agents?
authors_zh: Jiale Liu、Huajun Xi、Shaokun Zhang、Yifan Zeng、Tianwei Yue、Chi Wang、Jian Kang、Qingyun Wu、Huazheng Wang
paper_type_zh: 多模态智能体失败归因基准与构造流程
best_for_zh: 研究智能体轨迹、失败归因、因果注入、评测器与多模态长上下文审计的读者
one_line: Who&When Pro reports 12,326 controlled failed trajectories across 3 modalities and 26 benchmarks with responsible-agent, decisive-step, and error-mode labels, while the official data and evaluation code remain unavailable.
Who&When Pro 报告 12,326 条跨 3 种模态与 26 个基准的受控失败轨迹，并提供责任智能体、决定性步骤和错误模式标签，但官方数据与评测代码尚未公开。
why: It turns agent debugging into a concrete episode-level evaluation contract and tests whether frontier models can localize causal failures, while demonstrating why successful anchors, discarded injections, evaluator versions, replay state, label corrections, and actual release artifacts must be audited before a benchmark can support training or reproducible evaluation.
inclusion_reason: Who&When Pro defines a high-value environment-linked failure-attribution object: a full agent episode is paired with responsible-agent, earliest-decisive-step, and error-mode labels created through successful-prefix replay and evaluator-confirmed failure. It also exposes core audit questions around intervention fidelity, dropped recoveries, mixed evaluators, taxonomy coverage, multimodal context, and paper-versus-release divergence.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Who&When Pro is a 2026 arXiv benchmark paper by nine authors for automated failure attribution in AI agents. It asks three linked questions about a failed execution: which agent or component caused the failure, which step was the earliest decisive error, and which error mode best describes that cause. The predecessor Who&When contains 184 text-only traces from 127 agentic systems; Who&When Pro targets broader scale and modality coverage because failures in stronger agents are harder to localize and a terminal wrong answer alone does not identify what should be repaired. (Paper §1; Table 1.)

The paper reports 12,326 failed trajectories drawn from 26 public source benchmarks, nine task categories, 15 agent frameworks, 18 error modes, and text, image, and video. A benchmark instance is described as a source task and reference answer, a full ordered execution with agent messages/actions, tool or environment observations and intermediate artifacts, plus labels for responsible agent, decisive step, and one error mode. It belongs to Environment and Agent Trajectory Data because the attribution target is attached to a state-action episode and depends on the source environment's terminal evaluator, not merely on a standalone answer.

The boundary is equally important. Who&When Pro evaluates diagnosis of already failed traces; it does not train a policy, PRM, reward model, or RL agent, and it does not establish that attribution labels improve self-evolution. The official repository at inspected commit db3946cae6895c8056b9b482c283fc3949a6654f contains only README.md and one illustration. Its README says evaluation code and benchmark data are not public yet, while the project page's Data button points only to #. Thus the paper-scale 12,326 trajectories must not be confused with the public release, which currently exposes zero benchmark rows, zero successful seeds, and zero evaluator scripts. This Card is L4-ready as a reading and audit artifact, not as evidence of a reusable dataset release.

Who&When Pro 是一篇由 9 位作者完成、发表于 2026 年 arXiv 的 AI 智能体自动失败归因基准论文。它围绕一条失败执行提出三个相互关联的问题：哪个智能体或组件造成了失败、哪一步是最早的决定性错误，以及哪个错误模式最能描述该根因。前作 Who&When 只有来自 127 个智能体系统的 184 条纯文本轨迹；Who&When Pro 扩展规模与模态，是因为更强智能体的失败更难定位，而一个错误的终局答案本身并不能说明应当修复哪里。（论文 §1；Table 1。）

论文报告 12,326 条失败轨迹，来源覆盖 26 个公开基准、9 个任务类别、15 个智能体框架、18 种错误模式以及文本、图像和视频。论文描述的一条基准实例包括来源任务与参考答案、按顺序记录的完整执行，其中含智能体消息/动作、工具或环境 observation 和中间 artifact，并附责任智能体、决定性步骤与一种错误模式标签。它属于“Environment and Agent Trajectory Data”，因为归因目标附着在 state-action episode 上，并依赖来源环境的终局 evaluator，而不是只附着在孤立答案上。

边界同样重要。Who&When Pro 评测的是对既有失败轨迹的诊断；论文没有训练 policy、PRM、reward model 或 RL 智能体，也没有证明归因标签能够改善 self-evolution。核验时的官方仓库 commit db3946cae6895c8056b9b482c283fc3949a6654f 只包含 README.md 和一张示意图；README 明确称评测代码与基准数据尚未公开，项目页的 Data 按钮也只指向 #。因此，论文规模的 12,326 条轨迹不能与公开发布混为一谈：当前官方工件公开的基准记录、成功 seed 和 evaluator 脚本数量均为 0。本 Card 的 L4 就绪含义仅是可供阅读与审计，并不代表数据集已经可复用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a controlled way to turn a successful agent episode into a failed episode whose first changed action is intended to be the decisive-error label. For a successful seed trajectory, the pipeline chooses an eligible step conditioned on a plausible failure mode. An unnamed frontier model writes an adaptive injection prompt, that prompt is patched into the original base-agent call, and the base agent emits the corrupted action in its own style. The system then resumes from the same agent and records the downstream consequences. A trajectory is kept only if the source task evaluator now marks it failed.

Warm starting is the key mechanism. Earlier injection pipelines can rerun from the beginning, so stochastic actions may drift before the intended injection and make causal attribution ambiguous. Who&When Pro instead replays the successful prefix before substituting one action. Static search, page, and image calls are served from a SHA-256-keyed SQLite cache; stateful browser and code actions are re-executed with fidelity checks that abort divergent attempts. Reverting the substituted action recovers the known successful seed under the construction, so its producing component and coordinate supply the responsible-agent and decisive-step labels. One of 18 taxonomy modes supplies the failure-class label. (Paper §3.3; Appendix F.3.)

The feedback contract is mixed and episode-level. Source benchmark evaluators decide whether an injection changed success to failure; the released description does not provide one uniform evaluator or scalar reward. Attribution models are then scored against constructed labels with responsible-agent accuracy on multi-agent traces, exact decisive-step accuracy, error-mode macro-F1, and Joint accuracy requiring all three. The evaluator can observe terminal task success and the attribution prediction, but it does not prove that the injected action is the unique semantic root cause for a human reader. Three-annotator validation partly audits this gap: majority approval is 94% for step and 90% for both agent and error family, with 2% judged to have no clear decisive error.

Relative to Who&When's small expert-curated text set and AEGIS-style reroll injection, the direction signal is not simply more traces. It is the combination of multimodal full episodes, exact-prefix replay, intervention-conditioned labels, and explicit agent/step/mode evaluation. Its strongest unresolved question is whether those labels and environments remain faithful outside controlled single-error interventions; the unavailable rows and replay assets currently prevent that audit.

本文的核心贡献，是用受控方式把一条成功智能体 episode 转化为失败 episode，并把首次被替换的 action 作为预期的决定性错误标签。对于一条成功 seed，流水线依据合理的错误模式选择可注入步骤；一个身份未披露的 frontier model 生成自适应 injection prompt，再把该 prompt 拼接到原 base-agent 调用中，由 base agent 以自身风格产生错误 action。随后系统继续运行同一智能体，并记录下游后果。只有当来源任务 evaluator 把新轨迹判为失败时，该轨迹才会保留。

Warm start 是关键机制。较早的注入流程可能从头 rerun，随机 action 会在预定注入点之前发生漂移，使因果归因变得含糊。Who&When Pro 在替换一个 action 前精确 replay 成功前缀。静态搜索、页面和图像调用由以 SHA-256 为键的 SQLite cache 提供；有状态浏览器和代码 action 则重新执行，并通过 fidelity check 中止发生漂移的尝试。在该构造下，恢复被替换的 action 就能回到已知成功 seed，因此产生该 action 的组件和坐标分别给出责任智能体与决定性步骤标签；18 种 taxonomy mode 中的一种给出错误类别标签。（论文 §3.3；Appendix F.3。）

反馈契约是 mixed 且附着于完整 episode。来源基准 evaluator 判断注入是否把成功转成失败；公开描述并未给出一个统一 evaluator 或 scalar reward。归因模型再与构造标签比较，指标包括仅用于多智能体轨迹的责任智能体准确率、精确决定性步骤准确率、错误模式 macro-F1，以及要求三者同时正确的 Joint 准确率。Evaluator 能观察终局任务成功与归因预测，但不能证明注入 action 对人类读者而言就是唯一语义根因。三位标注者的验证对这一缺口进行了部分审计：step、agent 与 error family 的多数通过率分别为 94%、90% 和 90%，另有 2% 被判定为没有清晰的决定性错误。

相对于 Who&When 的小规模专家标注纯文本集合和 AEGIS 风格的 reroll 注入，本文的方向价值并不只是轨迹更多，而是把多模态完整 episode、精确前缀 replay、干预条件标签以及 agent/step/mode 评测组合起来。最重要的未决问题，是这些标签和环境能否在受控单错误干预之外仍保持忠实；当前缺失的数据记录与 replay 工件使这一审计无法进行。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are tasks from 26 public academic benchmarks executed through 15 single- and multi-agent frameworks. Appendix F.2 identifies GPT-4.1 and Gemini 3 Flash as the primary base models, but says the model varies by agent/benchmark pair. The collection logs task inputs, agent messages, observations, intermediate artifacts, and terminal answers, then applies the official source evaluator when available to partition runs into successes and natural failures. Counts for these two source partitions are not disclosed.

Natural failures and successes have different roles. PhD-level reviewers inspect sampled natural failures, identify the earliest decisive errors, consolidate recurring patterns into 18 modes across six families, and create per-agent/benchmark applicability profiles. Natural failures are not benchmark instances. Successful runs are injection seeds. For a chosen plausible failure mode, the sampler removes invalid steps and applies position preferences—for example, planning earlier and verification after evidence collection—but exact distributions, attempts per seed, retries, seeds, and thresholds are unknown.

Injection has two model calls. An unnamed frontier model reads the task, reference answer, seed context, and target mode and generates a specific adaptive injection prompt. The original base agent receives that prompt in its step call and produces the erroneous action. The framework replays all earlier actions, substitutes that single action, then lets the original system continue. Static factual tool outputs are returned from a synchronous SQLite cache keyed by the SHA-256 of canonicalized parameters. For page visits, only raw page content is cached; the secondary LLM summary can vary. Browser/code state is rebuilt by replaying actions through fresh Playwright/code-executor instances, and an exception or detected divergence aborts the attempt. Appendix F.3 reports that Bing DOM rotation accounts for 89% of input_text replay failures.

Selection retains only post-injection continuations that the task evaluator marks failed. Additional filters remove construction-prompt leakage and cases where the correct answer was already salient before injection. The final reported output is 12,326 failed traces spanning 51% text, 42% image, 7% video and 76% single-agent versus 24% multi-agent. Mean/max length is 7.5/50 steps, with 1,139 words per trace and 152 words per step; multimodal traces average 1.3 images. The paper does not publish successful seeds, natural failures, failed injection attempts, post-injection successes, replay aborts, rejected records, exact rules, or a row schema.

Evaluation prompts 10 frontier models with all-at-once, step-by-step, or binary-search protocols. The default shows the complete trace without the reference answer and asks for Agent Name, Step Number, Error Mode, and a short reason; all traces fit native model context windows without truncation. There is no training optimizer. Reproduction requires the 12,326 rows, source task IDs/versions, model snapshots, taxonomy profile, prompts, cache, environment snapshots, evaluator versions, filter ledger, prediction files, and subset manifests. None except the paper-level description is currently public. (Paper §§3–4; Tables 2–3; Appendices F, J, K.)

输入是来自 26 个公开学术基准的任务，并由 15 个单智能体和多智能体框架执行。Appendix F.2 指出主要 base model 是 GPT-4.1 与 Gemini 3 Flash，但具体模型随 agent/benchmark pair 而变化。采集过程记录任务输入、智能体消息、observation、中间 artifact 和终局答案，再在可用时用官方来源 evaluator 把运行划分为成功与自然失败；这两个来源分区的数量均未披露。

自然失败与成功轨迹承担不同角色。PhD 级 reviewer 检查抽样自然失败，识别最早决定性错误，把重复模式归并为六个 family 下的 18 种 mode，并建立各 agent/benchmark 的适用 profile。自然失败本身不进入基准；成功运行则作为 injection seed。针对选定且合理的错误模式，sampler 排除无效步骤并采用位置偏好，例如较早注入 planning error、在收集证据后注入 verification error；但精确分布、每个 seed 的尝试次数、retry、随机种子和阈值均为 unknown。

注入包含两次模型调用。身份未披露的 frontier model 读取任务、参考答案、seed context 和目标 mode，生成具体的自适应 injection prompt；原 base agent 在该步骤调用中接收 prompt 并产生错误 action。框架 replay 此前全部 action、替换这一个 action，再让原系统继续。静态事实性工具输出来自同步 SQLite cache，cache key 是规范化参数的 SHA-256。对于页面访问，只缓存 raw page content，二级 LLM summary 仍可变化。浏览器/代码状态通过新建 Playwright/code-executor instance 并 replay action 重建；异常或检测到的漂移会中止尝试。Appendix F.3 报告 Bing DOM rotation 占 input_text replay failure 的 89%。

筛选只保留被任务 evaluator 判为失败的注入后 continuation；额外过滤会移除 construction prompt 泄漏，以及注入前 context 已明显包含正确答案的案例。最终报告输出为 12,326 条失败轨迹，其中 51% 为文本、42% 为图像、7% 为视频，76% 为单智能体、24% 为多智能体。平均/最大长度为 7.5/50 步，每条轨迹平均 1,139 个词、每步 152 个词；多模态轨迹平均含 1.3 张图像。论文没有公开成功 seed、自然失败、失败的注入尝试、注入后成功、replay abort、被拒绝记录、精确规则或 row schema。

评测使用 all-at-once、step-by-step 或 binary-search protocol 提示 10 个 frontier model。默认设置在不提供参考答案的情况下展示完整轨迹，要求输出 Agent Name、Step Number、Error Mode 和简短理由；所有轨迹均适配模型原生 context window，无需截断。论文没有训练 optimizer。复现需要 12,326 条记录、来源任务 ID/版本、模型 snapshot、taxonomy profile、prompt、cache、环境 snapshot、evaluator 版本、过滤 ledger、预测文件和 subset manifest；除论文级描述外，这些当前均未公开。（论文 §§3–4；Tables 2–3；Appendices F、J、K。）

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Table 4 evaluates ten frontier models with the all-at-once protocol. On text traces, Qwen3.5-122B obtains the highest responsible-agent accuracy at 57.5 and exact step accuracy at 73.9; GLM-5 obtains the highest error-mode macro-F1 at 22.2 and Joint accuracy at 25.3. On image traces, Qwen3.5-122B reaches 70.4 agent accuracy, GPT-5.4 reaches 65.2 step accuracy and 30.2 Joint, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 reaches 29.5 error F1. On video, GPT-5.4 reaches 85.1 agent accuracy, Claude Sonnet 4.6 reaches 64.4 step accuracy, Gemini 3 Flash reaches 40.0 error F1, and Llama-4 Maverick reaches 30.4 Joint. No model dominates every metric or modality.

The failure surface changes with modality. Figure 4 aggregates step accuracy at 69% for text, 62% for image, and 60% for video, whereas error-mode accuracy rises from 17% to 24% to 37%. Planning, verification, and coordination causes are frequently collapsed into reasoning symptoms. Trace length is another boundary: representative step accuracy falls from 94% below 3K tokens to 50% above 12K. These are author-reported results on unavailable rows and predictions, not independent reproductions.

Protocol ablations use a stratified subset of 1,444 traces. All-at-once gives the best Joint accuracy for 8 of 10 models and improves step accuracy by 7.6 percentage points over step-by-step. Relaxing exact localization to Step@1 produces average gains of 13.9 points on text, 16.9 on image, and 28.1 on video; the additional Step@2 gains are 4.4, 6.0, and 2.6. This indicates that many video misses are adjacent-step errors, while step-by-step tends to commit before the labeled error.

Ground-truth answers are not uniformly helpful. Section 4.5 and Appendix B show that giving the answer improves perception-error classification but degrades or leaves reasoning-error classification flat: the judge can shortcut to an outcome mismatch and skip the earlier root cause. Human validation independently exposes label uncertainty. Across 100 stratified traces and three annotators, majority approval is 94% for step, 90% for agent on multi-agent traces, and 90% for error family; 2% have no clear decisive error and Fleiss' kappa is 0.73.

The strongest artifact evidence is negative. Appendix A states that all traces, labels, and evaluation code are released, yet the official GitHub README says data and evaluation code are not public and the repository contains no implementation or rows. This discrepancy does not invalidate the paper's experiments, but it prevents verification of every result, split, label correction, evaluator decision, and scale claim beyond the manuscript. (Tables 3–4; Figures 4–7 and 12–14; official repository.)

Table 4 使用 all-at-once protocol 评测 10 个 frontier model。在文本轨迹上，Qwen3.5-122B 的责任智能体准确率和精确步骤准确率最高，分别为 57.5 与 73.9；GLM-5 的错误模式 macro-F1 和 Joint 准确率最高，分别为 22.2 与 25.3。在图像轨迹上，Qwen3.5-122B 的 agent accuracy 为 70.4，GPT-5.4 的 step accuracy 与 Joint 分别为 65.2 和 30.2，Claude Sonnet 4.6 的 error F1 为 29.5。在视频轨迹上，GPT-5.4 的 agent accuracy 为 85.1，Claude Sonnet 4.6 的 step accuracy 为 64.4，Gemini 3 Flash 的 error F1 为 40.0，Llama-4 Maverick 的 Joint 为 30.4。没有模型在所有指标和模态上占优。

失败面随模态变化。Figure 4 汇总的文本、图像和视频 step accuracy 分别为 69%、62% 和 60%，error-mode accuracy 则从 17% 增至 24% 和 37%。Planning、verification 与 coordination 根因经常被归为 reasoning 症状。轨迹长度也是重要边界：代表性模型的 step accuracy 从低于 3K token 时的 94% 降至高于 12K 时的 50%。这些都是作者在尚未公开的记录和预测文件上报告的结果，未经独立复现。

Protocol 消融使用含 1,444 条轨迹的 stratified subset。All-at-once 在 10 个模型中的 8 个上取得最高 Joint，并比 step-by-step 的 step accuracy 高 7.6 个百分点。把精确定位放宽到 Step@1 后，文本、图像和视频的平均增益分别为 13.9、16.9 和 28.1 点；进一步放宽到 Step@2 的增益分别为 4.4、6.0 和 2.6。这说明视频上的许多错误属于相邻步骤偏差，而 step-by-step 容易在标签步骤之前过早提交判断。

Ground-truth answer 并不总是有帮助。§4.5 与 Appendix B 表明，提供答案会改善 perception-error 分类，但会降低 reasoning-error 分类或使其不变：judge 可能通过终局不匹配走捷径，并跳过更早根因。人工验证也独立揭示标签不确定性。在 100 条分层轨迹和 3 位标注者上，step、multi-agent agent 与 error family 的多数通过率分别为 94%、90% 和 90%；2% 没有清晰决定性错误，Fleiss' kappa 为 0.73。

最强的 artifact 证据是一项负面发现。Appendix A 称所有轨迹、标签与评测代码均已发布，但官方 GitHub README 明确表示数据和评测代码尚未公开，仓库中也没有实现或记录。这一矛盾本身不能推翻论文实验，却使读者无法在 manuscript 之外核验任何结果、split、标签修正、evaluator 决策或规模主张。（Tables 3–4；Figures 4–7 与 12–14；官方仓库。）

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline is failure attribution from naturally failed or synthetically corrupted agent traces. Who&When uses 184 text traces and expert labels; MAST, TRAIL, AgentErrorBench, AEGIS, AgenTracer, and AgentRx expand scale, taxonomy, or attribution methods but remain text-only in Table 1. AEGIS reports 9,533 injected failures, while Who&When Pro reports 12,326 across text, image, and video and includes both single- and multi-agent topologies.

The concrete change is replay discipline. In reroll-based injection, stochastic behavior can diverge before the intended corrupted step, so the injected location is not necessarily the earliest difference from a successful run. Who&When Pro reconstructs a successful prefix, substitutes exactly one action generated by the original base agent under an adaptive error prompt, and retains the resulting episode only when the task evaluator flips to failure. This joins a contrastive success anchor, environment replay, a controlled intervention, a terminal outcome, and agent/step/mode labels in one construction contract.

The components are not individually new. Public benchmark tasks, ReAct and multi-agent frameworks, tool caching, browser replay, LLM-generated error prompts, failure taxonomies, official task evaluators, LLM attribution prompts, and exact/macro-F1 metrics all predate this paper. The contribution is their composition at multimodal scale and the attempt to strengthen label provenance from “a model says this step failed” to “this is the first deliberately changed step relative to a successful execution.” It remains controlled synthetic causality rather than proof of natural causal necessity.

This matters for reasoning data because it introduces an intermediate feedback surface between coarse terminal failure and free-form critique. A future released row could support attribution evaluation, failure-conditioned retrieval, data filtering, or supervised diagnosis. Before such reuse, one must verify the successful-seed link, injection action, task evaluator, replay state, rejected attempts, human corrections, source-task overlap, and rights. Without those objects, the novelty can be studied as a recipe and audit target but not treated as an open training corpus.

最接近的 baseline 是从自然失败或合成破坏的智能体轨迹中进行失败归因。Who&When 使用 184 条纯文本轨迹和专家标签；MAST、TRAIL、AgentErrorBench、AEGIS、AgenTracer 与 AgentRx 扩展了规模、taxonomy 或归因方法，但在 Table 1 中都仍是 text-only。AEGIS 报告 9,533 条注入失败，而 Who&When Pro 报告 12,326 条，覆盖文本、图像、视频以及单智能体和多智能体 topology。

本文真正改变的是 replay discipline。在基于 reroll 的注入中，随机行为可能在预定错误步骤前就发生漂移，因此注入位置未必是相对成功运行的最早差异。Who&When Pro 重建成功前缀，在自适应错误 prompt 下由原 base agent 生成并替换恰好一个 action，且只有当任务 evaluator 把结果翻转为失败时才保留 episode。这把对照成功 anchor、环境 replay、受控干预、终局 outcome 和 agent/step/mode 标签接入同一个构造契约。

各组成部分本身并非都由本文首次提出。公开基准任务、ReAct 与多智能体框架、工具 cache、浏览器 replay、LLM 生成错误 prompt、失败 taxonomy、官方任务 evaluator、LLM 归因 prompt，以及 exact/macro-F1 指标都早于本文。贡献在于以多模态规模组合这些组件，并试图把标签 provenance 从“某模型认为这一步失败”增强为“相对成功执行，这是第一个被故意改变的步骤”。但它仍是受控合成因果，而不是对自然因果必要性的证明。

这对 reasoning data 的意义，是在粗粒度终局失败和自由文本 critique 之间引入一个中间反馈面。未来若记录公开，可以用于归因评测、失败条件检索、数据过滤或监督诊断。复用前必须核验成功 seed 链接、注入 action、任务 evaluator、replay 状态、被拒绝尝试、人工修正、来源任务重叠和权利。缺少这些对象时，只能把创新点作为 recipe 与审计对象研究，不能当作开放训练语料。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The central modeling assumption is a single controlled error. Real agent failures can arise from several weak actions, delayed environment changes, interacting agents, hidden state, or successful recovery. The 18-mode taxonomy is explicitly non-exhaustive, and its applicability profiles come from sampled natural failures whose count and sampling procedure are unknown. Consequently, the reported benchmark characterizes failures that the injection pipeline can express and retain, not the full natural failure distribution.

“Golden by construction” is a useful but bounded claim. The 3-annotator majority review accepts 94% of step labels, 90% of agent labels on multi-agent traces, and 90% of error-family labels, while 2% have no clear decisive error. A substituted action may be the first controlled difference and still be semantically ambiguous, especially when its downstream symptoms resemble another family. Models frequently map planning, verification, and coordination causes to reasoning errors. Providing the task answer can worsen root-cause diagnosis by steering the judge toward the final mismatch.

Selection hides resilience. Only injections that make the source evaluator fail survive; post-injection successes, self-corrections, replay aborts, leakage-filtered traces, and cases with a salient answer are dropped. Because the task-evaluator inventory, versions, thresholds, outputs, and false-positive/false-negative audits are unavailable, this can select evaluator-sensitive failures and remove the counterexamples needed to learn when an apparent error is recoverable. This is a curator inference from the stated filter contract, not an author-reported training result.

Replay is only partly frozen. Static factual tool calls use a cache, but page-summary LLM outputs are deliberately not cached. Stateful browser and code sessions are re-executed on fresh instances; Bing DOM rotation causes 89% of reported input_text replay failures. No cache, snapshot, environment image, dependency lock, retry ledger, or fidelity output is released, so exact causal replay cannot be audited.

The experiment has no disclosed train/dev/test split. The 100 human-review traces and 1,444 ablation traces have no public IDs or overlap manifest. All tasks originate in 26 public benchmarks, but deduplication, task grouping, model contamination, and benchmark overlap are unknown. The paper says no PII is present and no human subjects are involved, yet reviewer recruitment, compensation, consent, raw corrections, and redaction evidence are not disclosed.

Release is the blocking limitation. Appendix A says all traces, labels, and evaluation code are released; the official repository says the opposite and currently publishes only a README and one image. Dataset/code licenses are unknown, and the manuscript's CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license must not be transferred to unreleased artifacts. No successful seed, natural failure, retained injected failure, rejected attempt, evaluator, prediction, or runnable environment is publicly available.

核心建模假设是单个受控错误。现实智能体失败可能来自多个弱 action、延迟环境变化、智能体交互、隐藏状态或成功恢复。18-mode taxonomy 被作者明确说明为非穷尽，其适用 profile 来自抽样自然失败，但数量与抽样流程均为 unknown。因此，论文报告的基准刻画的是注入流水线能够表达并保留的失败，而不是完整自然失败分布。

“由构造保证的 golden label”有价值但存在边界。3 位标注者的多数复核对 step 标签的通过率为 94%，对多智能体轨迹的 agent 标签为 90%，对 error-family 标签也为 90%，另有 2% 没有清晰决定性错误。一个被替换的 action 可以是首个受控差异，但在语义上仍可能含糊，尤其当其下游症状更像另一错误 family 时。模型经常把 planning、verification 和 coordination 根因归为 reasoning error；提供任务答案还可能把 judge 引向终局不匹配，从而削弱根因诊断。

筛选隐藏了韧性。只有使来源 evaluator 判为失败的注入才会保留；注入后成功、自我修正、replay abort、因泄漏被过滤的轨迹，以及答案已明显出现的案例都会被丢弃。由于任务 evaluator 清单、版本、阈值、输出和 false-positive/false-negative 审计不可得，这一流程可能偏向对 evaluator 敏感的失败，并移除学习“表面错误何时可恢复”所需的反例。这是根据筛选契约做出的 curator inference，不是作者报告的训练结论。

Replay 只实现了部分冻结。静态事实工具调用使用 cache，但页面 summary LLM 输出被刻意排除在 cache 外；有状态浏览器与代码 session 则在新 instance 上重新执行。Bing DOM rotation 占论文报告的 input_text replay failure 的 89%。由于 cache、snapshot、环境 image、dependency lock、retry ledger 和 fidelity 输出均未公开，无法审计精确因果 replay。

实验没有披露 train/dev/test split。100 条人工复核轨迹和 1,444 条消融轨迹都没有公开 ID 或 overlap manifest。全部任务来自 26 个公开基准，但去重、任务分组、模型污染与 benchmark overlap 均为 unknown。论文称不存在 PII 且不涉及人类受试者，但 reviewer 招募、报酬、同意、原始修正和脱敏证据未披露。

发布状态是阻塞性限制。Appendix A 称全部轨迹、标签和评测代码均已发布，但官方仓库明确表示尚未公开，当前只发布 README 与一张图。数据/代码许可证均为 unknown，不能把 manuscript 的 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可转移给未发布工件。当前没有任何成功 seed、自然失败、保留的注入失败、被拒绝尝试、evaluator、预测或可运行环境可公开取得。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Who&When Pro is currently safest as a reading/audit reference and a design specification for failure-attribution benchmarks. It gives a concrete target schema—task, full episode, responsible component, decisive step, error mode, and terminal outcome—and separates three signals that are often collapsed: environment success, intervention provenance, and a judge's diagnostic prediction.

For dataset construction, the warm-start recipe is a useful checklist. Preserve the successful seed and its task-evaluator output; log every prefix action and observation; record the chosen mode and injection slot; store the adaptive prompt and corrupted action; freeze static content and stateful environment versions; retain downstream continuations regardless of success; and attach every filter, retry, abort, human correction, and evaluator decision. A complete release should make success anchors and rejected failures queryable rather than publishing only failure-inducing interventions.

For evaluation research, the paper supports comparing all-at-once, step-by-step, and binary-search diagnosis under exact Step and relaxed Step@k; testing answer-visible versus answer-hidden prompts; stratifying by modality, topology, trace length, framework, and error family; and measuring both component localization and root-cause classification. Its results warn that a final reference answer can improve outcome checking while harming process diagnosis.

For post-training, the paper motivates—but does not demonstrate—SFT of diagnostic outputs, failure-conditioned retrieval, reward-model training, or self-evolution. Those uses are blocked because 0 benchmark rows are public, no dataset license exists, source-task contamination is unknown, successful and rejected traces are missing, and constructed labels have measurable human disagreement. Do not broaden training_use beyond evaluation and audit until a versioned release and rights review make the data object inspectable.

A future reuse gate should require row hashes and source IDs; complete successful/natural/injected/rejected counts; grouped splits; evaluator prompts/versions; human labels and corrections; API/model/framework commits; static caches and stateful snapshots; prediction files; code/data licenses; privacy/redaction rules; and a paper-to-release manifest resolving the present contradiction.

Who&When Pro 当前最安全的用途，是作为阅读/审计参考，以及失败归因基准的设计规范。它给出了具体目标 schema：任务、完整 episode、责任组件、决定性步骤、错误模式和终局 outcome，并区分了经常被混在一起的三种信号：环境成功、干预 provenance 与 judge 的诊断预测。

对于数据集构造，warm-start recipe 提供了一份有用清单：保留成功 seed 及其任务 evaluator 输出；记录每个前缀 action 与 observation；记录选定 mode 和 injection slot；保存自适应 prompt 与错误 action；冻结静态内容和有状态环境版本；无论下游成功与否都保留 continuation；并附上每项 filter、retry、abort、人工修正和 evaluator 决策。完整发布应当让成功 anchor 和被拒绝失败都可查询，而不应只发布能够诱发失败的干预。

对于评测研究，论文支持在精确 Step 与宽松 Step@k 下比较 all-at-once、step-by-step 和 binary-search 诊断；测试 answer-visible 与 answer-hidden prompt；按模态、topology、轨迹长度、框架和错误 family 分层；同时度量组件定位与根因分类。结果提醒读者：终局参考答案可能改善 outcome checking，却损害 process diagnosis。

对于 post-training，论文只提出动机但没有实证展示诊断输出 SFT、失败条件检索、reward-model training 或 self-evolution。这些用途当前受阻，因为公开基准记录为 0、没有数据许可证、来源任务污染为 unknown、成功与被拒绝轨迹缺失，而且构造标签存在可测量的人工分歧。在版本化发布和权利审查使数据对象可检查之前，不应把 training_use 扩展到 evaluation 与 audit 之外。

未来复用 gate 应要求：row hash 与来源 ID；完整成功/自然/注入/被拒绝数量；grouped split；evaluator prompt/版本；人工标签与修正；API/model/framework commit；静态 cache 与有状态 snapshot；预测文件；代码/数据许可证；隐私/脱敏规则；以及解决当前矛盾的 paper-to-release manifest。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep paper scale separate from release scale: the paper reports 12,326 failed traces across 26 benchmarks, nine task categories, 15 frameworks, 18 modes, and three modalities; official artifacts currently expose zero rows and zero evaluator code.
  • Follow the four trajectory populations: successful runs seed injection, natural failures build taxonomy profiles, evaluator-confirmed injected failures form the benchmark, and non-failing/aborted/filtered injections disappear. Only the third population has a reported count, and none are public.
  • Read Tables 2–4 together: traces average 7.5 steps, human approval is 94% step and 90% agent/error with 2% unclear, while frontier error-mode macro-F1 remains low enough that “golden” construction does not make diagnosis solved.
  • Inspect Appendix F.3 before accepting exact replay: static factual calls are cached, page summaries may vary, stateful environments are re-executed, and Bing DOM rotation causes 89% of reported input_text replay failures.
  • Treat Appendix A's release sentence as contradicted by current official state: the repository says code/data are coming soon, contains only two non-git files, has no dataset/code license, and supplies no split, lineage, contamination, prediction, or replay artifacts.

• 必须区分论文规模与发布规模：论文报告 12,326 条失败轨迹，覆盖 26 个基准、9 个任务类别、15 个框架、18 种 mode 和 3 种模态；官方工件当前公开的记录与 evaluator 代码数量均为 0。
  • 要追踪四类轨迹：成功运行用作 injection seed，自然失败用于构建 taxonomy profile，被 evaluator 确认的注入失败组成基准，未失败/中止/被过滤的注入则消失。只有第三类报告了数量，而且四类均未公开。
  • 应把 Tables 2–4 连起来阅读：轨迹平均 7.5 步，人工对 step 与 agent/error 的通过率分别为 94% 和 90%，另有 2% 不清晰；frontier model 的 error-mode macro-F1 仍然很低，因此“golden”构造并不代表诊断问题已经解决。
  • 在接受精确 replay 主张前先读 Appendix F.3：静态事实调用会缓存，页面 summary 仍可变化，有状态环境需要重新执行，而 Bing DOM rotation 占论文报告的 input_text replay failure 的 89%。
  • Appendix A 的发布表述应视为与当前官方状态冲突：仓库称代码/数据 coming soon，除 git 元数据外只有 2 个文件，没有数据/代码许可证，也不提供 split、lineage、污染、预测或 replay 工件。

items: Labels are called golden by construction, but human majority approval is 94% for decisive step and 90% for agent/error family, with 2% marked as having no clear decisive error; injected causality is not perfectly aligned with human-readable root-cause attribution.

The 18-mode taxonomy is explicitly non-exhaustive and is derived from sampled natural failures. Controlled injection may underrepresent emergent, multi-error, interaction-driven, recovery, and out-of-taxonomy failures.

Retaining only injections that flip the source evaluator selects for evaluator-sensitive failures and drops resilience/self-correction evidence. Mixed task evaluators can introduce false positives or false negatives, but their versions and outputs are not public.
The cache returns static factual tool outputs, but the page-summary model is rerun and allowed to vary, so observation context is not fully frozen even when raw page content is stable.

Stateful browser/code replay depends on fresh environments and action-level checks. Appendix F reports Bing DOM rotation behind 89% of input_text replay failures; aborted attempts and environment snapshots are unavailable.

Failure-mode classifiers often map planning, verification, and coordination causes to reasoning symptoms. Supplying the gold answer can make judges skip the root cause and focus on downstream outcome mismatch.
Step accuracy falls from 94% on traces below 3K tokens to 50% above 12K; incremental step-by-step evaluation also commits early and underperforms the full-trace protocol.

Public benchmark tasks and unpinned frontier APIs create contamination and version-drift risks. Exact task IDs, provider snapshots, prompts, temperatures, seeds, tool versions, and budgets are unknown.
The paper claims a complete release while official artifacts publish no data/evaluator. This blocks record-level verification of every scale, schema, label, split, license, privacy, and replay claim.
标签被称作按构造为黄金，但人类多数同意对决定性步骤为 94%、对智能体/错误族为 90%，另有 2% 被标为无明确决定性错误；注入的因果性与人类可读的根因归因并非完全对齐。
18 模式分类体系被明确为非穷尽，并源自抽样的自然失败。受控注入可能低估涌现、多错误、交互驱动、恢复与分类体系外失败。
仅保留翻转来源评测器的注入会选择评测器敏感的失败，并丢弃韧性/自我纠正证据。混合任务评测器可能引入假阳性或假阴性，但其版本与输出不公开。
缓存返回静态事实性工具输出，但页面摘要模型被重跑并允许变化，因此即使原始页面内容稳定，观察上下文也未完全冻结。
有状态浏览器/代码重放依赖于全新环境与动作级检查。附录 F 报告 Bing DOM 轮换导致 89% 的 input_text 重放失败；中止的尝试与环境快照不可用。
失败模式分类器常将规划、验证与协调原因映射为推理症状。提供金标准答案可使评审跳过根因并关注下游结果不匹配。
步骤准确率从低于 3K tokens 的轨迹上的 94% 降至高于 12K 时的 50%；增量逐步评测也会过早承诺，且弱于全轨迹协议。
公开基准任务与未钉扎的前沿 APIs 造成污染与版本漂移风险。精确任务 IDs、提供商快照、提示、temperatures、种子、工具版本与预算未知。
论文主张完整发布，而官方产物未发布数据/评测器。这阻碍对每一项规模、schema、标签、划分、许可、隐私与重放主张的记录级核验。
